prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories (adoption incentive, choose_path hint, finish copy, finish hint, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, finish redesign, home new_flow, home notification, home redesign, sign_in copy, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder).
For choose_path copy (2 tests) and choose_path redesign (2 tests), no clear effect was seen across any tests.
For home wait_info changes (4 tests), no winning effect was demonstrated, with three showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
For adoption redesign (3 tests), choose_path layout (2 tests), and sign_in hint (2 tests), results disagree and lack a reliable winning pattern.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Stage Interactive Grid Redesign: Redesign the companion selection screen into a dynamic visual grid layout with interactive trait highlights and live pet renders. (why: Adoption has the lowest completion rate in the onboarding funnel (66.2%), and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or visual confusion.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Verification Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop verification screen during setup where users explicitly confirm their pet appears on screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on the desktop or the app failing to open, while the waiting step averages 2336s.)
2: [finish, new_flow] First Desktop Interaction Practice Flow: Add an interactive practice dialog screen during onboarding completion for users to test speaking to and controlling their pet. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Command Deck Overview Redesign: Transform the home introduction into a two-column command deck highlighting pet hotkeys, visibility toggles, and status indicators. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to hide or talk to pets after setup, and the finish step mean time is over 5800 seconds.)
4: [choose_path, new_screen] Pre-Selection Companion Showcase Screen: Add a visual showcase screen right before path selection displaying short animated preview clips of desktop companions in action. (why: Choose path exhibits a high mean duration (514s), indicating user hesitation when deciding between ready-made and custom paths.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Clarification Hint: Add an explicit safeguard hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that signing in restores existing pets. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue category) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Render Status Ticker: Provide detailed step-by-step workspace configuration status during the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting duration has a median of 201s and a mean of 2336s, indicating users need clear feedback while waiting.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Alert Toggle: Add a system notification option on the final onboarding screen to alert users when their pet is ready to interact. (why: Finish step mean duration is 5815s, showing users frequently step away before onboarding fully completes.)
